data: Your next Heavy Melee attack against an enemy deals increased damage.
Damage from your ultimate applies a stun and deals bonus spirit damage after a short delay.
Your Bullets have a chance to become unavoidable, piercing through enemies and ignoring their Bullet Resistance.
Your next attack will fire twice in quick succession with increased damage and velocity. This attack consumes extra ammo.
Target an enemy NPC and consume it for 170% Bonus Souls and grants a powerful long lasting buff.
Your melee damage will restore ammo and apply a stacking bullet resist debuff on enemies. Heavy melee applies 2 stacks.
If the target reaches max stacks, they will be stunned.
Toggle: Continually sacrifice Health to improve fire rate, Debuff Resistance and Move Speed.
Throw a vacuum grenade, pulling all enemies into a small area and applying Slowing Hex.
Alt Cast to Target Unit Directly.
Your bullets temporarily steal Max HP from enemies. Enemies regain their stolen health when the debuff expires.
Your next parry protects you from the damage and effects of enemy abilities and items. On a successful spell parry heal and gain move speed and Spirit.
The next instance of high spirit damage you take is significantly reduced.
Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals bonus weapon damage.
Charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, causing abilities dealing more than 165 damage to deal additional damage. Ignores Spirit Resistance.
Inflict damage over time to a target, dealing damage based on their current health.
Decay's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.
Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities.
Gain bonus Move Speed and Slow Resistance.
Removes the Move Speed penalty while shooting.
Your next bullet will heal you based on what target you hit.
Landing a Headshot will reduce their Bullet and Spirit Resist and applies Healing Reduction.

Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, bonus fire rate, and reloads bullets on use. Until your next reload, your bullets deal bonus spirit damage based on your Spirit Power.
Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals bonus weapon damage, heal you, and briefly grants bonus move speed.
Weapon hits build up a burning effect, dealing spirit damage over time.
Abilities refresh to the base burn duration and weapon hits extend it.
Power up your weapon with a shock effect, making your bullets proc shock damage on your target. This shock damage bounces to enemies near your target. Occurs once per burst shot.
Channel an expanding storm cloud around you that damages all enemies within its radius. Enemies do not take damage when they are out of line-of-sight.
+55% Bullet Resist while channeling Storm Cloud
Charge forward, pulling enemies you hit. Pushing a hero into a wall applies stun.
If you collide with a hero you move faster during your charge.
On Hero Collide: +1.5 Weapon Damage for 6s
Gain bonus defensive attributes. Taking damage grants temporary regeneration for a portion of the damage taken.
Leap high into the air before crashing into the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying stun.
On cast, become Unstoppable for 5s and +6m Impact Radius
Lift an enemy hero into the air and then slam them towards the target location.
+1.5s Debuff Duration and +6m Throw and Cast Range
Deploy a turret that shoots enemies, dealing spirit damage over time. The turret expires after a limited lifetime.
Turrets deal reduced damage to troopers and objectives.
+25% Turret Fire Rate and +12s Turret Lifetime
Throw out your lasso, dealing spirit damage, pulling, and applying stun.
Using a Bounce Pad extends the duration of Spirit Lasso.
Launch out a mechanical hand that pulls the first character it hits, reeling them in.
Grapple Arm can be used on allies.
Turn to shadows and possess Ava. You gain bonus move speed that increases over time, and become hidden on the minimap.
Taking damage from an enemy hero resets your bonus move speed and puts Ava on a brief cooldown.
Gain Damage Amp over time, up to 18%. Lingers for 6s

Throw out a trap that begins to arm itself. Once armed, the trap will trigger when an enemy enters its radius, applying Curse and Movement Slow that interrupts, Silences, Disarms, and prevents item usage.
Hit the trap with a Charged Shot to detonate early with increased radius.
After 1.5s cast time, launch a spirit owl that you control and which explodes on impact, damaging and stunning enemies. Hold [W] to accelerate the owl.
Press Jump / mantle to release control. Gain permanent Spirit Power for each enemy hero killed with Guided Owl.
After hit, kills enemies that are below 22% Health
Deal damage to nearby enemies and heal yourself based on the damage done. Heal is stronger against enemy heroes.
Adds a debuff to enemies that lets Mo & Krill deal +15% Damage to them. Stacks and lasts 16s.
Hold the target in place, stunning them and dealing damage during the channel. If they die during, or within 3 seconds of Combo ending, you permanently gain max health.
+0.7s Duration and +40.0 Damage Per Second and increased scaling
After charging for 2s, release pulses that damage enemies and heal you based on the damage done.
While channeling Last Stand you have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist.
Morph into a large goo ball that deals damage and stuns enemies on impact. The ball grants large amounts of Bullet and Spirit resist, bounces off walls and can double jump.
+7s Duration, +0.3s Stun Duration, and +0.2 Spirit Scaling
Launch a sentient cloak that travels forward and damages enemies. You can press Ability 2 to teleport to its location.
Fire a bolt of magic that deals Damage, increasing as it travels. If you have an Assistant, they also cast Vexing Bolt at reduced damage.
Press Ability 1 to redirect the bolt towards your crosshairs.
Summon an Assistant at the targeted location. The Assistant attacks whenever you fire your weapon, dealing Damage.
While the Assistant is out, you can press Ability 2 to swap positions with your Assistant.
Casting Spectral Assistant also reloads your weapon.
Hex a target area and transforming all enemies into a Rabbit for a limited duration.
Rabbits are small and move faster, but take increased Damage and are unable to perform most actions.
Previous recorded cooldown change: 95s to 75s, October 10th, 2024.
